cutoff_rule: t-2 source-calendar date, conservative end of China-local day
economic_meaning: Fact kinds select declared scenario assumptions, not estimated returns or investment advice.

regulatory_constraint.basis: Illustrative compliance uncertainty; return sign unknown.

operational_disruption.basis: Hypothetical directly exposed business; magnitude and listed-company exposure are assumed.

approval_uncertainty.basis: Approval uncertainty may reduce exposure through role uncertainty aversion.

completed_transaction.basis: Completion date and novelty unknown in these cases; no new economic increment assigned.

static_information.basis: A static relationship or aspiration is not a newly completed event.

information_gap.basis: An uninformative reply does not itself establish adverse company conditions.

calendar_change.basis: Calendar availability is shared by all modes, not converted into a signed stock belief.

other.basis: Unidentified mapping, excluded from numeric contributions and recorded as unresolved.

aggregation: At most one contribution per kind, bounded sum of signals, maximum mapped uncertainty; prevent fact splitting from amplifying the signal.
keyword_aggregation: Bounded sum across unique matched tokens, maximum uncertainty; intentionally simple baseline, not semantic ground truth.
company_evidence_rule: Only reply text can generate confirmed company facts or keyword matches.
